name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-castle-dracula
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Castle Dracula
description:
Originally, this BG was only meant to be used for horizontal scrolling. However, I decided to complete it with tiles that meant to be used with vertical scrolling. Result is good. I used Lunar Magic Bitmap Pasting feature a 2nd time, because the first time when I added the BG into LM, I did notice some reds I didn't spot into Aseprite. How can you blame me. Those did look the same. Corrected this glitched behaviour of the BG with the color green and added the proper red color for the BG.
Uses 2 palettes. I thought it'd use more.

No credit needed.
